description:
Create a new ApparelHub store. Only a name is required. The store starts CLOSED — connect a fulfillment provider (Printful/Printify), then call activate_store to make it ACTIVE. In an agency account pass workspace=<uuid> to create it in a specific client workspace.

[#9d5cbc]

name.description: Store name (must be unique within the account).

workspace.description: Workspace uuid to scope to (agency accounts). Omit for the Default workspace.

name: create_store
